text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Every time I look at this plushie, 
I feel like I'll remember today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, could you hold a few of these 
for me too?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's so that I will never, ever forget 
today.
